title: Newmark Arranges Sale of Fully Leased IOS Redevelopment Site in Central Denver
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the $7 million sale of 1707-1761 E. 68th Avenue, a fully leased industrial outdoor storage (IOS) property situated on approximately 7.17 acres in Denver, Colorado.
